description.zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。
description.en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab of the IoT Platform console.
The ID of the cloud recording download task.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制

获取到的录像下载地址有效期为1小时。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

The obtained recording download URL is valid for 1 hour.

## QPS limit

The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 50.

> All RAM users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.
